title: Evidence-Based, Pending Evidence
preview: This week: wellness fads move into the supply closet, and the portal learns to bill for logging in.

jokes.setup: The hospital just opened an Integrative Wellness Wing with a crystal bar and a cold-pressed juice menu.
jokes.punchline: It was funded by cutting the budget for the thing that was actually integrated into patient care: nurses.

jokes.setup: The new patient portal now sends a notification every time a test result is ready to view.
jokes.punchline: Viewing it triggers a separate notification to your insurer that you looked, so they can begin the denial.

cartoon.caption: “The crystals aren’t covered, but neither are the bandages, so we’ve made peace with it.”
cartoon.alt: A doctor holds a glowing crystal and a bottle of green juice before shelves of crystals, candles and tonics while a patient in a gown waits on an exam table.
